description: Ask a connected service which values really exist, such as a spreadsheet's tab names, an Airtable base's tables and typed fields, a Typeform's questions or a Google account's calendars. Use it while configuring a node instead of guessing a name: a guessed tab or field deploys fine and only fails later on the user's real data. Read-only. Returns `options` (label and value pairs) or, for field pickers, `fields` with types and allowed values.

credentialId.description: A credential for the loader's provider — check_setup reports what is connected.

params.description: Loader-specific selectors, e.g. { spreadsheetId }, { baseId, tableId }, { sobject }.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.
